<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .

nltl:TRF010IceClassDesignationShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:ship ;
    sh:class nltl:ship ;
    sh:property nltl:TRF010IceClassPropertyShape ;
    sh:description """TRF-010, Ice Class Regulations and the Application Thereof, section 1.8: ships are assigned to ice classes IA Super, IA, IB, IC, II, or III. This shape represents the designation obligation and the closed controlled value set for the represented ice-class record. The source descriptions refer to structure, engine output, hull and navigational capabilities; those underlying capabilities are not represented by the supplied owner/property model and are therefore not invented or enforced here. Section 1.1 states that section 1.8 applies to all ships irrespective of year of build. Applicability and source-edition selection are caller-admitted research assumptions, not independently certified by this shape.""" ;
    sh:message "A supplied nltl:ship record must have exactly one recognized Finnish-Swedish ice-class designation." ;
    sh:order 1 .

nltl:TRF010IceClassPropertyShape
    a sh:PropertyShape ;
    sh:path nltl:iceClass ;
    sh:minCount 1 ;
    sh:maxCount 1 ;
    sh:class nltl:iceClassValue ;
    sh:in (
        nltl:iceClassIaSuper
        nltl:iceClassIa
        nltl:iceClassIb
        nltl:iceClassIc
        nltl:iceClassIi
        nltl:iceClassIii
    ) ;
    sh:message "iceClass must occur exactly once and be one of IA Super, IA, IB, IC, II, or III." ;
    sh:description """The six permitted values correspond exactly to section 1.8 paragraphs 1-6: IA Super, IA, IB, IC, II, and III. The supplied ontology declares nltl:iceClass as an object property with range nltl:iceClassValue. The RDFS domain assertion is not treated as an exclusive owner binding; this shape is scoped to the caller-admitted nltl:ship population.""" ;
    sh:order 1 .

nltl:TRF010SourceEvidence
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:description """Source requirement: TRF-010; source document: data/requirements/TRAFICOM_full.txt; document SHA-256: e0bf179c97a1535aa7d4d0dd5d4053edf5f3f4e7e028c49d14c3a31cc7c1e8ba; retained selection start offset: 17575; end offset: 22652; retained selection SHA-256: b2b5cfa500af3e02bdd7399cf29656dbc3dbb76605bb5aa2c8c290efd42fb1f9. The selected material includes sections 1 through 1.8 and chapter 2. Section 1.8 is retained in full in that selection. Source retrieval and retained provenance provide evidence only and are not independently verified legal-edition or eligibility predicates.""" .

nltl:TRF010UnresolvedContext
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:description """Unresolved source-context records remain material: the supplied resolver reports multiple matching references for section 1.8 and for section 1, and retains the source selection for review. The supplied admission declares the 2021 edition and synthetic ship population as caller-attested research assumptions. This graph does not infer applicability from missing data, construction dates, vessel identities, or absent tests, and does not enforce the unrepresented capability descriptions in section 1.8.""" .
<END_SHACL>
